33119407.finding: Describes the curatedTCGAData and cBioPortalData R/Bioconductor packages that provide integrated multiomic TCGA and cBioPortal datasets using the MultiAssayExperiment data structure for coordinated analysis with clinicopathological data.

37624866.finding: Presents the SingleCellMultiModal Bioconductor package that delivers curated single-cell multimodal landmark datasets (CITE-Seq, scNMT, 10X Multiome, etc.) integrated via the MultiAssayExperiment class to facilitate method development for multimodal single-cell analysis.
37624866.model: human single-cell multimodal (CITE-Seq, ECCITE-Seq, SCoPE2, scNMT, 10X Multiome, seqFISH, G&T)

37208161.finding: Introduces the RaggedExperiment R/Bioconductor data structure for lossless representation of ragged genomic-range data (mutations, CNV, methylation, open chromatin) that is compatible with MultiAssayExperiment for multimodal data analysis.

29092936.finding: Describes the MultiAssayExperiment R/Bioconductor package for coordinated representation, storage and operation on multiple diverse genomics assays, providing ready-to-analyze multi-omics objects including full TCGA data.
29092936.model: human cancer (TCGA) and other multi-omics datasets

40932530.finding: EasyMultiProfiler (EMP) is a streamlined multi-omics workflow using SummarizedExperiment and MultiAssayExperiment classes, organized into five modules (data extraction, preparation, support, analysis, visualization) for standardized and reproducible microbiome multi-omics analysis.

29925568.finding: MOFA is an unsupervised computational framework that infers latent factors capturing shared and modality-specific variation across multi-omics datasets, enabling sample subgrouping, imputation, and outlier detection.
29925568.model: system: human chronic lymphocytic leukaemia + single-cell; data type: multi-omics (mutations, RNA, methylation, drug response)

38355833.finding: The Analyst software suite (ExpressAnalyst, MetaboAnalyst, OmicsNet, OmicsAnalyst) provides a web-based workflow covering single-omics analysis, knowledge-driven biological network integration, and data-driven joint dimensionality reduction integration across transcriptomics, proteomics, and lipidomics.
38355833.model: system: human pancreatic islet and plasma; data type: multi-omics (transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics)

30657866.finding: DIABLO is a multi-omics integrative method in the mixOmics R/Bioconductor package that identifies correlated discriminative features across omics layers using sparse latent component analysis.
30657866.model: data type: multi-omics (mRNA, miRNA, CpGs, proteins, metabolites)

32916129.finding: An application study integrates longitudinal microbiome, metabolome, host epigenome and transcriptome data to identify IBS subtype-specific host-microbiome metabolic pathways such as purine metabolism.
32916129.model: system: human IBS patients; data type: microbiome, metabolome, epigenome, transcriptome

39019974.finding: clusterProfiler (Bioconductor R package) supports multiomics enrichment analyses, with demonstrated use for integrating metabolomics and metagenomics, annotating transcription factors, and characterizing single-cell data.
39019974.model: data type: metabolomics, metagenomics, single-cell transcriptomics

40593592.finding: GAUDI is a non-linear unsupervised multi-omics integration method using independent UMAP embeddings and density-based clustering that outperforms several state-of-the-art methods at uncovering non-linear relationships and latent factors across omics datasets.
40593592.model: system: cellular; data type: multi-omics (genes, proteins, metabolites)

35925427.finding: An uncertainty-aware dynamic integration framework that combines deep embedding and confidence prediction modules to weight omics types by their data quality for multi-omics tumor classification.
35925427.model: system: tumor samples; data type: multi-omics classification

34554215.finding: timeOmics is an R/Bioconductor package providing a generic analytical framework (pre-processing, modeling, clustering) for longitudinal multi-omics data integration to identify time-associated molecular features.
34554215.model: system: human diabetes; data type: longitudinal multi-omics (mRNA, metabolites, gut taxa, clinical variables)

33315104.finding: MOVICS is an R package that unifies 10 state-of-the-art multi-omics integrative clustering algorithms for cancer subtyping, including downstream characterization, visualization, and external validation via multiclass prediction.

39027644.finding: consICA is an R/Bioconductor package implementing consensus independent component analysis for reference-free deconvolution and extraction of biologically relevant signals from heterogeneous multi-omics data for patient stratification and integration.
39027644.model: system: cancer; data type: multi-omics molecular profiles

41278008.finding: SUMO is an open-source R package for generating factor-analysis-based simulated multi-omics datasets with controllable latent structures, noise and complexity to enable reproducible testing and validation of integration methods.

41120838.finding: MultiModalGraphics is an R/Bioconductor package that produces annotated scatterplots and heatmaps for multi-omics data, embedding statistical summaries (fold-changes, p-values, q-values, SDs) and interoperating with MultiAssayExperiment, limma, voom and iClusterPlus.

38105215.finding: TCGAplot is an R package that performs integrative pan-cancer analysis and visualization of TCGA multi-omics data, including differential expression, correlation with TMB/MSI/TIME/methylation, survival, ROC, and gene-set analyses.

40305217.finding: The authors developed a lipid–metabolite–protein network combining protein-protein, enzymatic and genetic interactions, implemented as a Shiny R package that uses hyperbolic embedding to visualize and rank molecules across omics layers for multi-omics integration.

37932270.finding: Through cross-cohort integrative analysis of 9 metagenomic and 4 metabolomic IBD cohorts, the authors identified consistent microbial taxa, metabolites and multi-omics biomarkers (AUROC 0.92–0.98) for IBD diagnosis.

41939867.finding: Integrative multi-omics of bulk, single-cell, spatial and blood transcriptomic data with machine learning identified a four-gene (CXCL13, IL33, TLR4, IGF1) signature of IPF and supported a causal gut-immune-lung axis via Mendelian randomization.

40785047.finding: By integrating 6 microbiome datasets and 8 host blood transcriptomic datasets, the study identified five 'microbe–metabolite–host gene' tripartite associations and microbial genera with diagnostic potential for atherosclerosis.

41052276.finding: A systematic review categorizes, compares and evaluates computational methods for longitudinal multi-omics integration in microbiome and host studies, organizing them into statistical modeling, machine learning, dimensionality reduction and latent factor approaches.

39358810.finding: Integration of plasma proteomics, metabolomics, and gut/saliva metagenomics from 87 AD patients identified SKAP1, NEFL, homovanillate, glutamate and Paraprevotella clara as predictors of AD severity validated by AI-based models.

36624530.finding: Multi-omics (16S, metatranscriptomics, metabolomics) profiling of 495 subjects identified IBS-associated taxa, transcripts and metabolites and built random-forest classifiers distinguishing IBS subtypes.

39870302.finding: Integrative 16S, metaproteomic, metabolomic and host proteomic analyses in 30 children with severe ASD identified Tyzzerella enrichment, Bifidobacterium/Klebsiella-derived metaproteins and altered neurotransmitters linking gut microbiota to neurodevelopmental deficits.

39660865.finding: Parallel microbial profiling, transcriptomics and metabolomics of tumor and adjacent tissues from 50 glioma patients linked intratumoral bacteria to synapse-associated genes and bacterial-associated metabolites via mediation analysis.
